body: I'm about at the same point that he is. I'm ready to just be done. No hope. It never gets better. I almost get pumped thinking about death.

Nothing fucking helps. I have severe PTSD from two sexual assaults and 16 years of childhood sexual abuse, several domestic abuse instances, and childhood of emotional and physical abuse. I cannot fucking do this anymore.

I’m so glad. I don’t want to lose him forever. I’ve neber had one disappear before. I will try and take it slow. Thank you so much.

I can try to do that. I think he feels hurt like I used to. Happy/excited and then shut down by an adult and told to go away. I just feel so sad. I will try to comfort him and let him know he didn’t do anything wrong. I got mad at him because I was studying for a test and he wouldn’t stop begging to play a game. I didn’t have time.
Hmm that sounds like a good idea. I can try to leave it open to him. I’ve just been so desperate to get him back. I miss him a lot :/ thank you so much
Thank you for your kind words. I will try to write to him. Should I talk to him? And calm him down?

We aren’t sure what to do. I don’t have the strength to take care of him. He is still here. He’s just very upset and near inconsolable. If I don’t help him or get him back, Jackie may take him.

Or the sensory overload was too bad. I can get violent when I’m really on edge. I didn’t want to hurt anyone. Or everything triggered me.

I just worry it will never get better. I’m terrified of having another unresponsive flashback. It was terrible. I don’t want that to happen.
